amendment_class: outcome-independent fail-closed contract and inference hardening

reason.checkpoint_gate: A non-empty checkpoint is not sufficient evidence that temporal kernel size was the sole changed variable.
reason.block_gate: The frozen parent partition and every block file must be identical across kernels and seeds.
reason.winner_gate: A single winner must beat both alternatives and remain directionally stable over the three registered seeds.
reason.cost_gate: Scheduled-stimulus cost ends when selected EEG evidence is available, not at the final selected onset.

outcome_access_declaration.effective_timing: before the first v4-valid cross-kernel analysis
outcome_access_declaration.completed_checkpoint_policy: may be reused only after the complete v4 checkpoint gate passes
outcome_access_declaration.previous_block_predictions_or_analyses: quarantined and never mixed into v4

runtime_lock.binding: the runner hard-codes the detached lock SHA-256 to avoid a manifest-runner hash cycle
runtime_lock.preflight_correction: Expected architecture is instantiated so classifier_features and all other derived fields are included; the previous classmethod record omitted classifier_features and rejected all 36 checkpoints before any v4 prediction.

training_contract.source_qc: drop row when any channel PTP >= 100 uV
training_contract.refit: all exact source complement rows surviving QC for best_epoch+1; val_group_frac=null
checkpoint_requirements: source_subjects exactly equal cache subject set
training_subjects and dataset/cache keys exactly equal cache minus holdout
QC row and label counts recompute exactly
source prior and analytic calibration match refit rows
input mean/std recompute from exact refit rows and observed-channel mask
complete architecture record matches registered kernel arm

analysis_contract.inference_scope: conditional on the frozen three seeds, four target-excluded blocks, checkpoints, and GTN development cohort
analysis_contract.training_randomness_inference: not estimated with n_seed=3; use the descriptive seed stability gate
single_winner_requires_for_each_of_both_: paired subject bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
block_result_invariants: block subject set exactly equals frozen parent block for every kernel and seed
truth, candidate counts, and R_s are identical across all arms per subject
cache, endpoint, QC, pooling, checkpoint, and ledger hashes match
